title: Inline Styles
description: Learn when and how to use inline styles in React.

data.text: React allows you to apply styles directly to elements using the `style` prop. Unlike HTML, React inline styles use camelCase property names and values in an object.

data.title: Inline Style
Dynamic
data.content: Styles based on state or props

data.title: Limitations
data.text: Inline styles don't support pseudo-classes (:hover, :focus), media queries, or CSS animations. Use CSS modules or styled-components for complex styling.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Inline styles use camelCase property names
Values are strings (except for pixel values)
data.takeaway: Use inline styles sparingly - mainly for dynamic values.
